editorial.thesis: A hospitality city of about 407,000. Its retail is thin on desserts, sweets & ice cream and fitness & wellness — and 4% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 59% of Bhopal's. 6.39 chain outlets per lakh residents against 10.87 in Bhopal; 15 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 5, Reliance Smart / Fresh 3, Baskin Robbins 2.

The mapped economy leans to hotels & stays. Shares of all mapped places: hotels & stays 12.8% (Bhopal 7.0%); offices 5.9% (Bhopal 10.0%); services & crafts 4.0% (Bhopal 6.6%). Raw counts would mislead because Bhopal is mapped more completely (16,390 places against 3,085), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 1 zones hold 4% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Bherugarh alone has about 14,000 residents and 3 mapped food & drink places.
Retail is less concentrated than in Bhopal. 50% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Bhopal 51%). The largest cores are M.L.Nagar · Madhonagar (903 places) and Ujjain (495).

The widest brand gaps against Bhopal. Domino's 5 outlets vs 25; Café Coffee Day 1 outlets vs 19; Raymond 2 outlets vs 17. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 6 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Bhopal, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. M.L.Nagar · Madhonagar and Ujjain are the largest zones by residents (165,000 and 100,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 50% of all commercial places, and M.L.Nagar · Madhonagar alone lists 903.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. M.L.Nagar · Madhonagar holds 14 of the 26 tracked chain outlets, and Gujrati Samaj · City adds 6.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. M.L.Nagar · Madhonagar and Ujjain lead on education places (154 and 54, with 61 and 21 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Bherugarh. The blue cores include M.L.Nagar · Madhonagar.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (16,390 places in Bhopal against 3,085 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Bhopal; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Bhopal, Ujjain's mapped places over-index on hotels & stays (12.8% vs 7.0%) and under-index on offices (5.9% vs 10.0%), services & crafts (4.0% vs 6.6%), healthcare (6.8% vs 10.5%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 26 outlets of 15 tracked national brands within 6 km — 6.39 per lakh residents against Bhopal's 10.87 (193 outlets of 34 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Bhopal are Domino's (5 vs 25); Café Coffee Day (1 vs 19); Raymond (2 vs 17). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Bhopal's, so low means thin by Bhopal's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 6 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Ujjain's age mix against Bhopal: children (0–14) 27.4% vs 26.0%, 15–24 19.1% vs 21.1%, working age 44.6% vs 45.5%, 60+ 8.9% vs 7.4%. Under-25s are 46% of residents.

zones.456010: Reasonably supplied: 903 places for about 165,000 residents (index 110), 14 chain outlets.
zones.456001: Reasonably supplied: 495 places for about 100,000 residents (index 100), 3 chain outlets.
zones.456006: Reasonably supplied: 330 places for about 98,000 residents (index 67), 6 chain outlets.
zones.456003: An under-served zone: about 14,000 residents, 17 mapped places, 3 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 24.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 4.5% of mapped places against 5.0% in Bhopal — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 5 (Bhopal 25), Pizza Hut 1 (Bhopal 7). No mapped outlet in either city: Haldiram's, Biryani By Kilo.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 2.5% of mapped places against 2.6% in Bhopal, so the mix is level. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 1 (Bhopal 19), Chai Sutta Bar 1 (Bhopal 0). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.3% of mapped places against 0.7% in Bhopal — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 2 (Bhopal 6). No mapped outlet in either city: Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.1% of mapped places against 1.4% in Bhopal — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 3 (Bhopal 9), Vishal Mega Mart 2 (Bhopal 2). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 0.8% of mapped places against 1.5% in Bhopal — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Apollo Pharmacy, MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 4.4% of mapped places against 5.3% in Bhopal — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Raymond 2 (Bhopal 17), Bata 2 (Bhopal 11), Tanishq 2 (Bhopal 4), Pantaloons 1 (Bhopal 3).
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 7.8% of mapped places against 7.7% in Bhopal, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 3.7% of mapped places against 3.9% in Bhopal, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 2.3% of mapped places against 4.3% in Bhopal — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
